messages:
jess: quick thought exercise 11 for the new auto-switchover controls: should console show discrete trigger inputs (p95, error%) or one combined 'safety band' slider?
ryan: discrete. teams correlate latency vs error differently. one slider hides the nuance and will confuse SREs.
priya: agree discrete, but add a compact preset dropdown (low-risk, balanced, aggressive) for product folks. keep advanced panel collapsed by default.
ajess: fine by me. proposed defaults for hosted: p95=350ms, error_rate=0.5%. thoughts?
alex: 350ms is aggressive for long-seq gen; maybe allow route-specific presets (chat vs embedding vs rerank).
ryan: do route presets + ability to inherit org defaults. also expose what event types count toward error_rate: 5xx, model-timeout, model-internal, inference_rejection. ui should list them.
jess: yup must be explicit. users keep asking "why didn't it fallback" when classifier mapped differently.
priya: usability idea: show a tiny sample preview area with three columns: matched events, total events, estimated switch %. compute from last 24-72h sampled telemetry.
ops-bot: heads-up: full scan of 72h raw events is heavy. recommend sampling windows and a default sample_pct=5% for preview.
maya: what about audit sampling for the actual rollout? if auto-fallback is on we need enough data to replay later. suggest audit_sample_pct=2% default, canary=15%.
ryan: +1. document costs and show cost-estimate inline. add a checkbox: "capture full payload for replay" default off unless private deployment.
priya: privacy note: in hosted, full payload capture requires consent; show a red privacy badge if enabled.
ops-bot: security reminder: playback API and captured events access must be restricted and auditable.
ryan: oscillation protection: propose debounce_ms and min_stable_requests. e.g. debounce_ms=90000, min_stable_requests=50. also implement exponential backoff windows: 10m, 30m, 2h.
jess: makes sense. UX point: show a small state machine graphic on rollout page: healthy -> degraded -> switched -> cool-down. clickable steps open sample events.
alex: for operator overrides: require a reason and optional TTL. show override badge in timeline and prevent auto-revert until TTL expires unless operator clears.
priya: make operator override create an audit event and optional slack/email notify. add a small 'undo' action for 5m after override.
maya: error classifier authoring: offer a WYSIWYG rule builder: dropdown fields (status_code, msg_contains, latency_gt, kv_cache_miss) + boolean glue (AND/OR). live match preview on sample.
ryan: we should include a server-side safe-eval for expressions, limit regex complexity and execution time. deny expressions that scan entire payload frequently.
jess: runtime telemetry needs to tag events with which rule matched to ease debugging. add 'last_matched_rule' field in the event sanitized payload.
ops-bot: note: tagging will increase storage slightly. estimate +8% event size if we add rule id tags.
priya: fine, but surface cost tradeoff in the UI. also allow customers to opt-out of tagging.
alex: accessibility: console should surface "why" in plain english next to each automatic action: e.g., "Switched due to sustained p95 > 350ms over 15m window (matched 2.3% of requests)".
ryan: expose playback endpoint: `GET /api/v1/rollouts/{id}/playback?from=&to=&sample_pct=` with role checks. include a dry-run param for preview.
ops-bot: scheduled task: run sample-sim job on staging with 72h @5% tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
jess: i'll mock the UI: two numeric inputs + preset dropdown, advanced panel with rule builder, preview pane, hysteresis controls, audit sample toggle, override flow, and cost/privacy badges. posting designs by EOD.
priya: i'll update runbook checklist: audit retention, operator escalation steps, override review cadence.
maya: i'll prototype the sampler backend and add metrics on query latency/cost.
ryan: i'll add API spec and a small migration note for existing rollout configs. we should auto-map old "error-only" rules to the new classifier format.
jess: perfect. thanks all. :sparkles:
ops-bot: meeting: prototype review tomorrow 11:00am PT. reminder sent.
maya: adding a task: test hysteresis behavior under flapping traffic in staging loadgen.
priya: and i'll draft the help doc text for each control and the example scenarios.
ryan: cool. closing loop: we'll aim to ship the console preview + playback API in the next sprint.
jess: awesome, thanks team :rocket:
